accepted.receipt_note: The receipt sha256 is informational and is not compared: the receipt carries evaluated_on (the build day) and so changes on every rebuild even when the data and the index are identical. What is compared is the policy sha256, complete_through (which must also be the last index day), the index point count, the index, high-water mark and maximum drawdown to 4 decimals, and that every recorded missing daily date is a day on the index path (filled by its span return).

change_rule: A proof whose complete_through, point count, index (4 decimals) or missing points differ from this record is not covered by it: it reads PENDING_OWNER_ACCEPTANCE until the owner reviews the change.
